lines.zh: 蜗牛在森林里慢慢爬行
lines.en: The forest is a slow, steady stroll.

lines.zh: 蜗牛在平原上寻找食物
lines.en: Scouring the plains for a tasty snack.

lines.zh: 蜗牛在沼泽中小心移动
lines.en: Boggy ground, but I must find a way through.
Drinking from the river, a refreshing treat.
Mushrooms, my favorite! I must be careful.
Sunlight feels so good on a day like today.
Danger, I must hide and be still.
Oh, an opportunity to change my look.
Carrots, my favorite! Time to take a break.
Oh, a perfect snack, I must eat it quickly.

lines.zh: 蜗牛拖着黏液，爬过苔藓。
lines.en: The snail drags a slime trail over moss.

lines.zh: 蜗牛沿着胡萝卜叶往上爬。
lines.en: The snail climbs a carrot leaf.
The snail shifts across a river stone.

lines.zh: 蜗牛在蘑菇岛绕开孢子。
lines.en: On the mushroom island it skirts the spores.
Its foot pushes the shell along.

lines.zh: 蜗牛从沼泽的烂泥里挣出。
lines.en: It pulls free of swamp mud.

lines.zh: 蜗牛静静地待在草地上
lines.en: Resting on the grass, life is good.
A moment's peace under the leafy canopy.
A warm stone, perfect for a rest.

lines.zh: 蜗牛在沙子上留下痕迹
lines.en: Leaving my mark on the sandy ground.
Mushrooms make for perfect little beds.
The gentle breeze, so invigorating.
Watching the world go by, so serene.

lines.zh: 蜗牛在原版染料中变换颜色
lines.en: Changing colors, life is colorful.
A carrot awaits, a moment to linger.
An apple here, a sweet stop indeed.

lines.zh: 蜗牛把长触角一直伸出去。
lines.en: The snail stretches its long tentacles.
The snail pulls into its shell from the rain.

lines.zh: 看到玩家走过来感到好奇，伸出了触手
lines.en: I wonder if I can reach for that player.
Hi there, a snail friend!

lines.zh: 对玩家皱眉，可能是因为玩家触碰了它
lines.en: You touched me! Frowns, you know.

lines.zh: 用触手轻触玩家的手，好奇的看着玩家
lines.en: I just wanna say hi with my tentacles.

lines.zh: 悄悄接近玩家，想偷看玩家的背包
lines.en: Curiosity, it's a dangerous thing.

lines.zh: 闻了闻玩家，似乎在辨别玩家的味道
lines.en: You smell like... something interesting.

lines.zh: 对玩家做了一个滑稽的动作，希望玩家能注意到它
lines.en: Hey, look at me, I'm a snail!

lines.zh: 对玩家露出了友好的微笑
lines.en: I'm harmless, you know.

lines.zh: 对玩家眨眼，似乎在玩一个捉迷藏游戏
lines.en: Wink, wink, nudge, nudge.

lines.zh: 突然伸长触手，试图抓玩家的裤子
lines.en: Oops, shouldn't have done that.
Hole in Shell
Slower Now
Step Back

lines.zh: 壳上多了个缺口，我走得更慢。
lines.en: With a chip in my shell, I crawl even slower.
Antenna Damaged
Speed Slowed
Gel Less
Shell Hurt
Move Difficult
Health Down

lines.zh: 真香！不过还得慢慢来，一步一步来嘛。
lines.en: Yum! But I need to take it slow, one step at a time.

lines.zh: 嘿，你手里拿的是啥？给我来一个呗，我正缺这个呢。
lines.en: Hey, what you got there? Give me one, I could use it.

lines.zh: 嘿，胡萝卜！来一根？我可是个吃货！
lines.en: Hey, carrot! Want one? I'm a bit of a snacker!

lines.zh: 苹果也行！来吧，我有点口渴。
lines.en: Apple works too! I'm thirsty.

lines.zh: 你那边有水果吗？给我来个！
lines.en: Any fruits over there? Give me one!

lines.zh: 你手里拿的不是苹果吗？给我来一个，我已经很久没吃了。
lines.en: Isn't that an apple? Give me one, I haven't had one in a while.

lines.zh: 嘿，你手里拿的是什么？来一根？我正饿着呢。
lines.en: Hey, what you got there? One for me? I'm starving.
Hey, one for me? I could use it.

lines.zh: 嘿，胡萝卜！来一根？我正缺这个。
lines.en: Hey, carrot! One for me? I could use it.

lines.zh: 嘿，你手里拿的是啥？来一根？我已经很久没吃过了。
lines.en: Hey, what you got there? One for me? I haven't had one in a long time.
Slime splashed on me!
This carrot is delicious!
Annoying little bug...
Ouch, stepped on!
I need to go back into my shell!

lines.zh: 黏液球粘得我动不了啦！
lines.en: I can't move with all this slime ball stuck to me!
You're like a little hill...
Get away! There's danger ahead!
I only eat plants!

lines.zh: 真希望森林里多点小伙伴！
lines.en: Wish there were more friends in the forest!

lines.zh: 壳被撞得一歪，我晃了晃。
lines.en: My shell tipped; I swayed.
You stepped in my slime.
I'm staying in my shell now.
I slid a good way from that shove.

lines.zh: 找到伴侣了，我们要繁殖了！
lines.en: Found a mate, we're going to reproduce!

lines.zh: 嘿，来吧，让我们在一起吧！
lines.en: Hey, let's be together!
It's my duty to find a mate!

lines.zh: 我们的黏液球能帮助新生！
lines.en: Our slime balls can help the new one!
I'll protect my partner!

lines.zh: 让我们一起走过森林吧！
lines.en: Let's walk through the forest together!

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会很坚强的！
lines.en: Our child will be strong!

lines.zh: 我们需要找到一个安全的地方！
lines.en: We need to find a safe place!
My slime dried; let's take it slow.
Let's leave love behind!

lines.zh: 背着重重的壳，我缓慢地前行。Shell heavy, I move slowly.
lines.en: I carry my heavy shell and move slowly.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜是我的美食，也是我繁殖的秘诀。Carrot is my delicacy, and it’s also the key to reproduction.
lines.en: Carrot is my favorite food and key to reproduction.

lines.zh: 在平原上，我能发现许多美味的胡萝卜。On plains, I can find many delicious carrots.
lines.en: I can find lots of yummy carrots on the plains.

lines.zh: 黏液球是我的守护之物，也是我的自卫武器。My mucus ball is my guardian and defensive weapon.
lines.en: Mucus balls are my protectors and defensive weapons.

lines.zh: 森林中的朋友似乎对我不太友好。Forest friends don't seem very friendly to me.
lines.en: Forest friends aren't exactly kind to me.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水让我感到有些湿滑，但我还是努力前进。The swamp's water makes me a bit slippery, but I keep moving forward.
lines.en: The swamp's water makes me a bit slippery, but I keep moving.

lines.zh: 河边的青草是我喜爱的零食。Grass by the river is my favorite snack.
lines.en: Grass by the river is a tasty snack for me.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛上的蘑菇我可不吃，太苦了。I don't eat the mushrooms on the mushroom island; they're too bitter.
lines.en: I don't like the mushrooms on the island, they're too bitter.

lines.zh: 夜晚来临，我更喜欢在树荫下休息。At night, I prefer to rest under the trees.
lines.en: At night, I prefer to rest in the shade of the trees.

lines.zh: 黏液球能吸引蜜蜂为我工作。My mucus ball can attract bees to work for me.
lines.en: My mucus balls can attract bees to work for me.

lines.zh: 远处的阴影，是猎人的脚步声吗？Shadow from afar, is it the hunter's footsteps?
lines.en: Shadow from afar, could it be the hunter's footsteps?

lines.zh: 我要躲避那些捕食者，它们会伤害我。I need to avoid those predators, they can hurt me.
lines.en: I need to avoid predators, they can harm me.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜的味道如此美妙，但别靠近我。The carrot taste so wonderful, but don't come too close to me.
lines.en: The carrot tastes so good, but stay away from me.

lines.zh: 这片平原是我的家，但猎人总会出现。This plain is my home, but hunters always appear.
lines.en: This is my home, but hunters always show up here.

lines.zh: 森林里的空气湿润，我感到很舒服。The air in the forest is moist, it feels good to me.
lines.en: The air in the forest feels nice and moist.

lines.zh: 沼泽中的泥泞让我有些滑倒。The swamp's mud makes me feel a bit slippery.
lines.en: The swamp's mud makes me feel a bit unstable.

lines.zh: 河边的清水能洗去我的疲惫。The cool water by the river washes away my tiredness.
lines.en: The river's cool water can wash away my tiredness.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛上的环境不适合我。The environment on the mushroom island isn't suited for me.
lines.en: The mushroom island's environment isn't right for me.

lines.zh: 夜晚的宁静让我可以安心休息。The calm of night lets me rest peacefully.
lines.en: The peace of night allows me to rest safely.

lines.zh: 黏液球可以粘住我的敌人，阻止他们靠近。My mucus balls can stick to my enemies, keeping them away.
lines.en: My mucus balls can stick to enemies, keeping them at bay.
Explorer's companion
Slow-moving companion
Body covered in slime
Little traveler in the forest
Little guy searching for food
Secret companion at night
Slow mover on the plains
Mud-covered stalker
珍视你的 friend
Gift of slime balls
Secrets have shells.
Slow, yet glad.
Hiding in the shell.
Slime attack coming.
Back off, stay away.
Slow threat.
Hide, don't be found.
Slime balls flying.
Power in the soft shell.
Slow but firm.

lines.zh: 缓缓爬行在草地上，我遇到了一只小兔。
lines.en: Crawling slowly on the grass, I met a little rabbit.

lines.zh: 在沼泽边，我看到了一片美丽的荷花。
lines.en: By the swamp, I saw a beautiful lotus.

lines.zh: 森林里，我的壳被树叶擦得发亮。
lines.en: In the forest, my shell was polished by the leaves.

lines.zh: 河流中，我遇到了一群小鱼。
lines.en: In the river, I met a school of small fish.

lines.zh: 蘑菇岛上，我的家很安全。
lines.en: On Mushroom Island, my home is safe.
At night, I hid under the leaves.
I climbed up the tall tree.

lines.zh: 我用黏液球攻击了敌人。
lines.en: I attacked the enemy with sticky balls.

lines.zh: 我吃了一个胡萝卜，感觉好多了。
lines.en: I ate a carrot and felt better.

lines.zh: 苹果是我最喜欢的美食。
lines.en: Apples are my favorite food.
Burnt by flames!
Fell too far!
Drowned in water!
Exploded nearby!
Arrows pierced me!
Dark magic weakened me!
Starved to weakness!
Lightning struck me!
Void tore through me!
